title: Submit a demo request successfully
description: This test verifies that a visitor can complete the public demo request form with all required details and receive a success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /demo
Fill name into the name field
Fill email into the email field
Fill company into the company field
Fill WhatsApp into the WhatsApp field
Select plan interest
Fill message into the message field
Check privacy consent
Submit the demo request form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the lead capture submission is completed

title: Block demo request submission without privacy consent
description: This test verifies that a visitor cannot submit the demo request form unless privacy consent is explicitly provided.

steps.description: Navigate to /demo
Fill name into the name field
Fill email into the email field
Fill company into the company field
Fill WhatsApp into the WhatsApp field
Select plan interest
Fill message into the message field
Submit the demo request form
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the demo request is not submitted

title: Continue from pricing into the demo request flow
description: This test verifies that a visitor can review the pricing page and move into the demo request flow from the pilot request path.

steps.description: Navigate to /precios
Scroll to the plan and contact section
Click the pilot request path
Verify the user reaches the demo request page
Verify the pricing page presents a manual lead-capture path instead of online checkout

title: Subscribe to the newsletter successfully
description: This test verifies that a visitor can enter a newsletter email, provide explicit consent, and see a successful subscription state.

steps.description: Navigate to /demo
Scroll to the newsletter section
Fill newsletter email into the newsletter email field
Check newsletter consent
Submit the newsletter form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the newsletter subscription is completed

title: Start a direct WhatsApp conversation from pricing
description: This test verifies that a visitor can use the WhatsApp contact path from pricing to start direct chat without going through checkout.

steps.description: Navigate to /precios
Scroll to the plan and contact section
Click the WhatsApp contact path
Verify a direct chat action is initiated
Verify the pricing page offers direct contact instead of an online payment flow

title: Block newsletter subscription without consent
description: This test verifies that a visitor cannot subscribe to the newsletter unless explicit newsletter consent is provided.

steps.description: Navigate to /demo
Scroll to the newsletter section
Fill newsletter email into the newsletter email field
Submit the newsletter form
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the newsletter subscription is not completed
